turns.text: Hey Mel! Good to see you! How have you been?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Hey Caroline! Good to see you! I'm swamped with the kids & work. What's up with you? Anything new?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: I went to a LGBTQ support group yesterday and it was so powerful.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, that's cool, Caroline! What happened that was so awesome? Did you hear any inspiring stories?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: The transgender stories were so inspiring! I was so happy and thankful for all the support.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, love that painting! So cool you found such a helpful group. What's it done for you?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: The support group has made me feel accepted and given me courage to embrace myself.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: That's really cool. You've got guts. What now?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Gonna continue my edu and check out career options, which is pretty exciting!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, Caroline! What kinda jobs are you thinkin' of? Anything that stands out?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: I'm keen on counseling or working in mental health - I'd love to support those with similar issues.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: You'd be a great counselor! Your empathy and understanding will really help the people you work with. By the way, take a look at this.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! That's really sweet. Is this your own painting?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Yeah, I painted that lake sunrise last year! It's special to me.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Wow, Melanie! The colors really blend nicely. Painting looks like a great outlet for expressing yourself.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! Painting's a fun way to express my feelings and get creative. It's a great way to relax after a long day.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Totally agree, Mel. Relaxing and expressing ourselves is key. Well, I'm off to go do some research.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Yep, Caroline. Taking care of ourselves is vital. I'm off to go swimming with the kids. Talk to you soon!
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Hey Melanie! Just wanted to say hi!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Hey Caroline! Good to talk to you again. What's up? Anything new since last time?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Hey Mel! A lot's happened since we last chatted - I just joined a new LGBTQ activist group last Tues. I'm meeting so many cool people who are as passionate as I am about rights and community support. I'm giving my voice and making a real difference, plus it's fulfilling in so many ways. It's just great, you know?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: That's awesome, Caroline! Glad to hear you found a great group where you can have an impact. Bet it feels great to be able to speak your truth and stand up for what's right. Want to tell me a bit more about it?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! It's awesome to have our own platform to be ourselves and support others' rights. Our group, 'Connected LGBTQ Activists', is made of all kinds of people investing in positive changes. We have regular meetings, plan events and campaigns, to get together and support each other.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, Caroline, your group sounds awesome! Supporting each other and making good things happen - that's so inspiring! Have you been part of any events or campaigns lately?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Last weekend our city held a pride parade! So many people marched through the streets waving flags, holding signs and celebrating love and diversity. I missed it but it was a powerful reminder that we are not alone in this fight for equality and inclusivity. Change is possible!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, fantastic, Caroline! Bet the atmosphere was incredible. Oh yeah, we went to the beach recently. It was awesome! The kids had such a blast.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Sounds fun! What was the best part? Do you do it often with the kids?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Seeing my kids' faces so happy at the beach was the best! We don't go often, usually only once or twice a year. But those times are always special to spend time together and chill.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Sounds special, those beach trips! Do you have any other summer traditions you all do together? Create those memories!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: We always look forward to our family camping trip. We roast marshmallows, tell stories around the campfire and just enjoy each other's company. It's the highlight of our summer!
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Wow, Mel, that's awesome! What's your best camping memory?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: I'll always remember our camping trip last year when we saw the Perseid meteor shower. It was so amazing lying there and watching the sky light up with streaks of light. We all made wishes and felt so at one with the universe. That's a memory I'll never forget.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Cool! What did it look like?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: The sky was so clear and filled with stars, and the meteor shower was amazing - it felt like we were part of something huge and awe-inspiring.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Wow, Mel. That must've been breathtaking!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: It was one of those moments where I felt tiny and in awe of the universe. Reminds me how awesome life is - so many little moments like that.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: That's great, Mel! What other good memories do you have that make you feel thankful for life?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: I'll never forget the day my youngest took her first steps. Seeing her wobble as she took those initial steps really put into perspective how fleeting life is and how lucky I am to be able to share these moments.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Aw, that's sweet, Mel! Those milestones are great reminders of how special our bonds are.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Yeah, they sure are. It's special moments like these that make me appreciate life and how lucky I am to be with my family and have our love.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Wow, Melanie, what a beautiful moment! Lucky you to have such an awesome family!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! I'm really lucky to have my family; they bring so much joy and love.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Hey Caroline! Last night was amazing! We celebrated my daughter's birthday with a concert surrounded by music, joy and the warm summer breeze. Seeing my kids' smiles was so awesome, and I'm so thankful for our special moments together.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Wow, sounds wonderful! Your love for your kids is so awesome. What concert was it? The advocacy event was a cool experience - so much love and support, amazing!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! It was Matt Patterson, he is so talented! His voice and songs were amazing. What's up with you? Anything interesting going on?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Wow, Mel, glad you had a blast at the concert. A lot's happened since we talked. I went to a pride parade last Friday and it was awesome - so much energy and love everywhere. Really made me proud and reminded me how important it is to keep standing up for equality.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, that's awesome! How did it feel being part of that community?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: It was so inspiring, Mel! Check out the crowd. People of all kinds celebrating love and acceptance - it really pushed me to keep fighting for LGBTQ rights.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, Caroline! That sounds awesome. This pic's from last night - looks like everyone was having a blast! Reminds me it's important to cultivate a loving and accepting environment for our kids. How do you stay inclusive in your work as an artist?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: That pic is cool! Representing inclusivity and diversity in my art is important to me. I also use it to speak up for the LGBTQ+ community and push for acceptance. Here's a recent painting!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, that rocks! What's the main idea of your art?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: My art is about expressing my trans experience. It's my way of showing my story and helping people understand the trans community.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Your art's amazing, Caroline. I love how you use it to tell your stories and teach people about trans folks. I'd love to see another painting of yours!
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks, Melanie. Here's one- 'Embracing Identity' is all about finding comfort and love in being yourself. The woman in the painting stands for the journey of acceptance. My aim was to show warmth, love and self-acceptance.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that's gorgeous! I love the self-acceptance and love theme. How does art help you with your self-discovery and acceptance journey?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Art's allowed me to explore my transition and my changing body. It's been a great way to work through stuff I'm going through. I love that it teaches me to accept the beauty of imperfections.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that's so cool! Art can be so healing and a way to really connect with who you are. It's awesome that beauty can be found in the imperfections. We're all individual and wonderfully imperfect. Thanks for sharing it with me!
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks, Melanie. It means a lot to share this with you.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Great chatting with you! Feel free to reach out any time.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Hey Mel! How're ya doin'? Recently, I had a not-so-great experience on a hike. I ran into a group of religious conservatives who said something that really upset me. It made me think how much work we still have to do for LGBTQ rights. It's been so helpful to have people around me who accept and support me, so I know I'll be ok!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Hey Caroline, sorry about the hike. It sucks when people are so closed-minded. Strong support really helps. FYI, I finished another pottery project - want to see a pic?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Sure thing, Melanie! Can't wait to see your pottery project.  I'm happy you found something that makes you happy. Show me when you can!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Here it is. Pretty proud of it! It was a great experience. Thoughts?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: That bowl is awesome, Mel! What gave you the idea for all the colors and patterns?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! I'm obsessed with those, so I made something to catch the eye and make people smile. Plus, painting helps me express my feelings and be creative. Each stroke carries a part of me.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: That's amazing! You put so much effort and passion into it. Your creativity really shines. Seeing how art can be a source of self-expression and growth is truly inspiring. You're killing it!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! Your words really mean a lot. I've always felt a strong connection to art, and it's been a huge learning experience. It's both a sanctuary and a source of comfort. I'm so glad to have something that brings me so much happiness and fulfillment.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Glad you found something that makes you so happy! Surrounding ourselves with things that bring us joy is important. Life's too short to do anything else!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Agreed, Caroline. Life's tough but it's worth it when we have things that make us happy.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Definitely, Mel! Finding those happy moments and clinging to them is key. It's what keeps us going, even when life's hard. I'm lucky to have people like you to remind me.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Yeah, same here Caroline. You make life's struggles more bearable.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! It means a lot having you in my corner. Appreciate our friendship!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: I appreciate our friendship too, Caroline. You've always been there for me.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: I'm always here for you, Mel! We had a blast last year at the Pride fest. Those supportive friends definitely make everything worth it!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: That was a blast! So much fun with the whole gang! Wanna do a family outing this summer?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Right, it was so much fun! We could do a family outting, or wanna plan something special for this summer, just us two? It'd be a great chance to catch up and explore nature! What do you think?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Sounds great, Caroline! Let's plan something special!
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Sounds great, Mel! We'll make some awesome memories!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Yeah, Caroline! I'll start thinking about what we can do.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Yeah, Mel! Life's all about creating memories. Can't wait for the trip!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Hi Melanie! Hope you're doing good. Guess what I did this week? I took the first step towards becoming a mom - I applied to adoption agencies! It's a big decision, but I think I'm ready to give all my love to a child. I got lots of help from this adoption advice/assistance group I attended. It was great!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Caroline, congrats! So proud of you for taking this step. How does it feel? Also, do you have any pets?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks, Mel! Exciting but kinda nerve-wracking. Parenting's such a big responsibility. And yup, I do- Oscar, my guinea pig. He's been great. How are your pets?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Yeah, it's normal to be both excited and nervous with a big decision. And thanks for asking, they're good- we got another cat named Bailey too. Here's a pic of Oliver. Can you show me one of Oscar?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: He's so cute! What’s the funniest thing Oliver's done? And sure, check out this pic of him eating parsley! Veggies are his fave!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Oliver's hilarious! He hid his bone in my slipper once! Cute, right? Almost as silly as when I got to feed a horse a carrot.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: That's so funny! I used to go horseback riding with my dad when I was a kid, we'd go through the fields, feeling the wind. It was so special. I've always had a love for horses!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, that sounds great - I agree, they're awesome. Here's a photo of my horse painting I did recently.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Wow, Melanie, that's amazing! Love all the details and how you got the horse's grace and strength. Do you like painting animals?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! Glad you like it. Yeah, I love to. It's peaceful and special. Horses have such grace! Do you like to paint too?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Painting's great for expressing myself. I love creating art! Here's a recent self-portrait I made last week.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Caroline, that's great! The blue's really powerful, huh? How'd you feel while painting it?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks, Mel! I felt liberated and empowered doing it. Painting helps me explore my identity and be true to myself. It's definitely therapeutic.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that's great! Art's awesome for showing us who we really are and getting in touch with ourselves. What else helps you out?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks, Melanie. Art gives me a sense of freedom, but so does having supportive people around, promoting LGBTQ rights and being true to myself. I want to live authentically and help others to do the same.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, Caroline! That's amazing. You really care about being real and helping others. Wishing you the best on your adoption journey!
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! I really appreciate it. Excited for the future! Bye!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Bye Caroline. I'm here for you. Take care of yourself.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Hey, Mel! How's it going? There's something I want to tell you. I went hiking last week and got into a bad spot with some people. It really bugged me, so I tried to apologize to them.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, Caroline! Sorry that happened to you. It's tough when those things happen, but it's great you apologized. Takes a lot of courage and maturity! What do you think of this?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! That plate is awesome! Did you make it?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Yeah, I made it in pottery class yesterday. I love it! Pottery's so relaxing and creative. Have you tried it yet?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Nah, I haven't. I've been busy painting - here's something I just finished.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow Caroline, that looks amazing! Those colors are so vivid, it really looks like a real sunset. What gave you the idea to paint it?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! I painted it after I visited the beach last week. Just seeing the sun dip below the horizon, all the amazing colors - it was amazing and calming. So I just had to try to capture that feeling in my painting.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, the beach really inspired you. The art really took me to that moment and I can feel the serenity. You captured the sunset perfectly, so peaceful!
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks Mel, really appreciate your kind words. It means a lot to me that you can feel the sense of peace and serenity. Makes me feel connected.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: I feel the same way! Art is so cool like that - it connects us and helps us understand each other. I was actually just remembering yesterday, spending the day with my fam volunteering at a homeless shelter. It was hard to see how neglected some people are, but it was great to feel like we could make a difference.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Wow, Mel, you're amazing! Volunteering and making a difference- it's so heartwarming. You're an inspiration to us all!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! I really appreciate your help and motivation. What made you decide to transition and join the transgender community?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Finding a community where I'm accepted, loved and supported has really meant a lot to me. It's made a huge difference to have people who get what I'm going through. Stuff like this mural are really special to me!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Caroline, glad you found a supportive community! Can you tell me more about why it's special to you?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: The rainbow flag mural is important to me as it reflects the courage and strength of the trans community. The eagle symbolizes freedom and pride, representing my own resilience and that of others.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: I'm in awe of your courage as a trans person. Have you made any more art lately?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks, Mel! I made this stained glass window to remind myself and others that within us all is the key to discovering our true potential and living our best life.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that looks amazing! What inspired it?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks! It was made for a local church and shows time changing our lives. I made it to show my own journey as a transgender woman and how we should accept growth and change.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, Caroline!  All those colors are incredible and the story it tells is so inspiring.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks, Mel! Glad you like it. It's a symbol of togetherness, to celebrate differences and be that much closer. I'd love to make something like this next!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, that's gorgeous! Where did you find it?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: I was out walking in my neighborhood when I came across this cool rainbow sidewalk for Pride Month. It was so vibrant and welcoming, I had to take a picture! It reminds us that love and acceptance are everywhere—even where we least expect it.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: That's so nice, Caroline! Art can be in the most unlikely places. Love and acceptance really can be found everywhere.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Agreed, Mel! Art can be a real mood-booster - I saw someone drawing on the ground the other day and it made me so happy. Creativity sure can lighten someone's day.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that's so nice! The colors are so bright and the flowers are so pretty. Art is such a source of joy.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks, Mel! Art gives me so much joy. It helps me show my feelings and freeze gorgeous moments, like a bouquet of flowers.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, did you make that? It looks so real!
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Yeah, definitely! Drawing flowers is one of my faves. Appreciating nature and sharing it is great. What about you, Mel? What type of art do you love?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Painting landscapes and still life is my favorite! Nature's amazing, here's a painting I did recently.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Wow, Mel! Any more paintings coming up?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: I'm feeling inspired by autumn so I'm planning a few. You got any cool art projects coming up?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: I'm putting together an LGBTQ art show next month and I'm gonna show my paintings. Super stoked!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that's awesome! Can't wait to see your show - the LGBTQ community needs more platforms like this!
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Yeah Mel, stoked! Gonna be a great night featuring LGBTQ artists and their awesome talents. We want it to spread understanding and acceptance - let's make it happen!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Hey Melanie, great to hear from you. What's been up since we talked?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Hey Caroline! Since we last spoke, I took my kids to a park yesterday. They had fun exploring and playing. It was nice seeing them have a good time outdoors. Time flies, huh? What's new with you?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Wow, your kids had so much fun at the park! Being outdoors can be really enjoyable. A lot happened since our last chat. I've been chasing my ambitions and had the chance to volunteer at an LGBTQ+ youth center. It was so gratifying to talk to similar young people. It made me remember how essential it is to be kind and show support.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: That sounds great, Caroline. Volunteering is a great way to meet people. Creating community and supporting each other, especially for kids, is really important. How did you feel about your time there? Anything that sticks out to you?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: I loved it. It was awesome to see how strong the young people were, with all the challenges they face. I felt fulfilled guiding and supporting them. I even got to let them know they're not alone by sharing my story. Such a powerful, emotional experience.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Was connecting with those young folks meaningful for you?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: It was so special to me. It reminded me of my own struggles in the past and how I felt alone. I was glad I could share my story and offer them support - it felt like I could make a difference.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: That's great. Sharing your story and support might make a difference for a long time. What do you hope to do next time?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: I'm definitely carrying on volunteering at the youth center. It's an important part of my life and I've made strong connections with people there. I really believe in community and supporting each other. So I wanna keep making a difference.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: That's great news, Caroline! Love seeing your dedication to helping others. Any specific projects or activities you're looking forward to there?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: We're putting together a talent show for the kids next month. I'm looking forward to seeing how much fun everyone has and how proud they'll feel of their talents!
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: That's so cool, Caroline! That's a great way to show off and be proud of everyone's skills. You know I love live music. Can't wait to hear about it!
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Wow! Did you see that band?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Yeah, that pic was from a show I went to. It was so much fun and reminded me of how music brings us together.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Wow, what a fun moment! What's the band?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: "Summer Sounds"- The playing an awesome pop song that got everyone dancing and singing. It was so fun and lively!
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: That sounds great! Music brings us together and brings joy. Playing and singing let me express myself and connect with others - love it! So cathartic and uplifting.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Cool! What type of music do you play?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Guitar's mostly my thing. Playing it helps me get my emotions out.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: That's awesome! What type of guitar? Been playing long?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: I started playing acoustic guitar about five years ago; it's been a great way to express myself and escape into my emotions.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Music's amazing, isn't it? Any songs that have deep meaning for you?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Yeah totally! "Brave" by Sara Bareilles has a lot of significance for me. It's about being courageous and fighting for what's right. Whenever I hear this jam, I think about the paths I've taken and the progress I've made.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: That's a gorgeous song, Caroline. It really fits with your journey and your determination to make a difference. Music can be so inspiring and uplifting.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! Appreciate it. You play any instruments?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Yeah, I play clarinet! Started when I was young and it's been great. Expression of myself and a way to relax.
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Cool! Got any fav tunes?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: I'm a fan of both classical like Bach and Mozart, as well as modern music like Ed Sheeran's "Perfect".
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Hey Mel, long time no chat! I had a wicked day out with the gang last weekend - we went biking and saw some pretty cool stuff. It was so refreshing, and the pic I'm sending is just stunning, eh?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Hey Caroline! It's so good to hear from you! That pic is so beautiful, the colors really pop. Biking sounds like a great way to get out in nature. We went camping with the kids a few weeks ago, had a blast exploring the forest and hiking. Nature can be so refreshing for your soul. Any plans coming up?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Melanie, that photo's amazing! I love all the yellow leaves, it looks so cozy. That sounds like fun! Seeing how excited they get for the little things is awesome, it's so contagious.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! It's awesome seeing the kids get excited learning something new about nature. Those moments make being a parent worth it. We roasted marshmallows and shared stories around the campfire. Those simple moments make the best memories. What inspires you with your volunteering?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: I'm inspired seeing my work make a difference for the LGBTQ+ community. Knowing I'm helping create a more loving world is amazing. I'm really thankful for my friends, family and mentors' support. It inspires me to keep making art, too.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that looks awesome! I love how it shows the togetherness and power you were talking about. How long have you been creating art?
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Since I was 17 or so. I find it soempowering and cathartic. It's amazing how art can show things that are hard to put into words. How long have you been into art?
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Seven years now, and I've finally found my real muses: painting and pottery. It's so calming and satisfying. Check out my pottery creation in the pic!
turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.text: Melanie, those bowls are amazing! They each have such cool designs. I love that you chose pottery for your art. Painting and drawing have helped me express my feelings and explore my gender identity. Creating art was really important to me during my transition - it helped me understand and accept myself. I'm so grateful.
turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.text: Hey Deb! So sorry for the late reply, been super busy. Last weekend my partner and I traveled to a meditation retreat for a few weeks in Phuket. Amazing experience! Nature, reflection and a break from engineering studies were awesome - it helped me find inner peace.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: I'd love to hear more about your reflections there and how they changed you.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: At the retreat, I had time to reflect on what makes me happy. It made me realize the importance of incorporating relaxation, self-care, and balance in life alongside my engineering studies. The beauty of nature there was so inspiring and refreshing!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Was there anything from the retreat that stood out to you?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: The one session that really stood out was about releasing expectations and judgments and just savoring the present. It was a strong reminder to not just dwell on the finish line, but to appreciate the journey too. I usually get too consumed with hitting my goals that I forget to appreciate the ride.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: I've been thinking about this a lot, too. Life's full of small moments and being grateful for those can really boost our happiness.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Yup, totally agree! Sometimes we get too focused on the big stuff and don't appreciate all the tiny wins. Like the feeling of the sun or a great cup of coffee - can be small but they make life much better. Trying to be more mindful and grateful to take it all in now.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: That's great, Jolene! Practicing mindfulness and gratitude can really change our day-to-day. Even just a different outlook can make the little things in life joyful. Glad you're getting into it!
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: I'm experiencing a new level of joy and happiness!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: It's wonderful to see your progress, and I'm excited to be on this journey with you!
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Thanks, Deb! Appreciate your support. It's great that we can do this together.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Having a supportive community definitely helps. We can motivate and encourage each other! By the way, I recently played a game. I don't remember what it's called. This is a card game about cats, where you take cards one by one from a deck, and then you can attack your opponent with them. We'll definitely play it with you!
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: I look forward to meeting you and playing this game!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Since speaking last, I reconnected with my mom's old friends. Their stories made me tear up and reminded me how lucky I am to have had her.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: It's great that you could reconnect with them. Hearing stories about our loved ones can be tough but also comforting.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Hearing stories about my mom was emotional. It was both happy and sad to hear things I hadn't heard before. It was a mix of emotions, but overall it was comforting to reconnect with her friends.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: It can bring up a range of emotions, and it's okay to feel a mix of happiness and sadness. Those moments with her friends must've been meaningful to you.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Wow, it was so special. A glimpse into her life beyond what I knew. Through their eyes, I appreciate her more. Here I am and my mom.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: That looks like a blast! What did you and your mom's friends do on that day?
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: We reminisced and looked through her photos. It was really sweet.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Looking at old photos must have been so nostalgic! It's great that you could share that experience with friends. It's amazing how photos and memories can give us a deeper appreciation for the people we love.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Pictures really have a way of bringing back memories and making us appreciate the special bond we have with our loved ones. They remind me of how strong love is and how amazing human relationships can be. Just like this one.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Wow, what a gorgeous pic! Do you have any special memories of that beach or just love surfing in general?
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: That beach is super special to me. It's where I got married and discovered my love for surfing. It's always filled with joy and peace.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: What pleasant memories.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Here is another photo from my classes.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Wow, that yoga pose looks amazing! Does it help you relax?
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Oh yeah! Doing this on the beach is so peaceful - the ocean, sand, and fresh air create a super relaxing atmosphere. The perfect way to take care of myself.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: I like to create my own serene yoga space with candles and oils for extra chill vibes. Also, we tried a new style of meditation in Thailand - with flowers.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Oh, same for me!
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: I find calm when I do yoga or meditate. I use essential oils and put on some soft, soothing music in the background to create a peaceful atmosphere. It really helps me chill out and center myself.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: It's amazing how our environment can enhance our practice.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Yeah, totally! Our surroundings can really affect our mood and how much zen we can get from our routine. Creating a place that feels safe and chill is key.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Wow, that looks so comfy and inviting! Where do you usually go to relax in your house?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: In my room, I usually go to relax and feel at ease. After a busy day, it's my little haven for peace and rest - the perfect spot to relax and recharge.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Sounds like your room does the job. That's awesome.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Here are my pals keeping me company.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: It's awesome how pets can bring us comfort and peace when we need it.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Susie is a great companion.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: The love pets give is priceless.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Plus, they make life a lot brighter!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Hey Jolene, I'm so excited to tell you! Yesterday, me and my neighbor ran a free gardening class for the community, it was awesome! People of any age joined in and it was such a great thing to see.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Wow, Deborah, that's awesome! Keep up the great work, and here's hoping for more events like this in the future!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Gardening is really amazing. It brings us together in such a cool way. It was awesome to share my love of plants and help people take care of the world. So, what about you? Anything new happened lately?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: We tried a scuba diving lesson last Friday and had an awesome time! We found a cool dive spot we can explore together. Trying new things opens up a world of adventure - maybe one day I'll be a certified diver. Anything fun going on with you?
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: That sounds amazing, Jolene! I've been interested in underwater life, but I haven't had the chance to try scuba diving yet. Recently, I've been spending time remembering my mom. Last Sunday, I visited her old house and sat on a bench. It was a comforting experience, as if I could feel her presence guide me and remind me of her love.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Visiting your mom's old home sounds like it was really special. Is there something special you remember about her?
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Thanks, Jolene! It was really special. My mom had a big passion for cooking. She would make amazing meals for us, each one full of love and warmth. I can still remember the smell of her special dish, it would fill the house and bring us all together.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Mmm, that looks delicious, Deb! So sweet how cooking with your mom brought everyone together. What's your best memory of cooking with her?
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: I loved it when she would bake pineapple birthday cakes for me when I was a kid. It always made me feel so special.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: No wonder it made you feel special.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Have you ever had something like that with someone close?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: I used to bake cookies with someone close to me.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: What's your favorite cookie to make?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: The warm, gooey chocolate and soft, buttery cookie are a match made in heaven.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: I really want to eat this now.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Well look what I have here!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Is there anything special about it or the photo?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: It takes me to another world when I read it!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: I think not, I really like it!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Having a space like this is important for escaping reality and relaxing with a book. Do you have any books that really moved you?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: My bathroom has an aesthetic vibe. Once I read a self-discovery book there and it really resonated with me.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Wow! A special book that speaks to you and helps with self-discovery? That's awesome. Plus, having a cozy nook to chill? That's my best one!
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Sounds nice, Deb! A cozy nook is a must! The beach is a great place for finding peace and relaxation. Have you ever tried surfing?
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Certainly! Here's the confirmation.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: How cool! But I never decided to try it.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: It'll be an adventure! Let's make it happen soon!
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: So glad, all that remains is to agree and choose the right time for both of us.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Let's plan for next month - I'll check my schedule and let you know. Can't wait!

turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Hey Jolene! It's great to hear from you. It sounds challenging but interesting! It must be really putting your creative and problem-solving skills to the test. How did you feel when you first received the project? Are you enjoying working on it?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: When I got it, I felt a mix of emotions - excited and nervous. But now, I'm really enjoying it! It's like trying to solve a puzzle, figuring out the best design and programming. Seeing the robot come together is awesome too!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: That's awesome, Jolene! You're enjoying the process. It must be really satisfying to see it come together. Keep up the good work! Oh, by the way, I met my new neighbor Anna yesterday!
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: How did you two meet?
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: It happened at yoga in the park.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Wow, that's awesome! It's great connecting with people who have similar interests. Did you two talk about it?

turns.text: Yeah, we talked about how it has improved our lives and the sense of community it gives.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Sounds great!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Have you ever thought about resuming yoga?

turns.text: Well... we planned to play the console with my partner.

turns.text: Thanks for the kind words!

turns.text: Gotta run bye!

turns.text: See you soon!

Music brings us together and helps us show our feelings. It reminds me of my mom and her soothing voice when she'd sing lullabies to me. Lucky to have those memories!
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Wow, festivals sound so fun! Here's me and my partner at one last year - had an awesome time! It's my way of expressing myself and getting away from all the stress of everyday life. Just got back from a trip with my partner - so cool!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Wow, what a gorgeous shot! It looks so tranquil and serene. You two look very happy together. Trips create awesome memories that we can share. Where did you go on your trip and what's something you'll never forget?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Thanks! We had an awesome yoga retreat. The place was so peaceful and the view during yoga was amazing - the sunrise lit up the whole sky with bright colors. It was so beautiful, it made us feel so alive and grateful.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Wow, what a view!  How did it make you feel?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: It was amazing! Doing yoga with that backdrop made me feel connected to nature and myself. I felt incredibly peaceful and thankful.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Like, it's no wonder looking at such beauty can really help us refocus and connect with who we are. Have you ever experienced that?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: I remember taking a hike with my partner and coming across a waterfall oasis. Everything just felt so peaceful and my worries just disappeared. It was such a refreshing experience.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Are you planning to experience it again soon?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Yeah! I'm planning to get out in nature again next month. It's going to be great reconnecting with it!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Enjoy it! This photo made me think of a gorgeous blossom tree from near my home. Every spring, it was magical to watch it bloom.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: That sounds magical! How was it watching the tree bloom each spring?
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: It was like admiring nature's artwork. It filled me with awe and made me appreciate the beauty of life. Even in tough times, there's hope for growth.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: This photo I took is a great visual representation of that idea. It reminds me that I can keep growing through any obstacles.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: It really captures resilience and strength. I love how you find inspiration in the small things.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Thanks, Deborah! Appreciating those small things is important. It helps me remember that even when times are tough, there's always something positive to hang onto.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: It's a great habit. Thanks for reminding me!
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Sure Deb, it's great catching up. Keep on finding those beauties!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Hey Deborah! Good to hear from you. How've you been? I've been on an emotional rollercoaster lately, but I'm coping.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you. All good here - how about you? Anything new happening lately?

turns.text: I had a major milestone last week and it went really well - I'm so relieved and proud. It was a huge accomplishment for me as an engineer.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: That's awesome. You must have worked really hard for that. I'm so proud of you. Care to share more about it?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Thanks so much! I had to plan and research a lot to design and build a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need. It was tough, but I loved the experience.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Your engineering skills really made a difference for people in a rural area. That's amazing! How did it feel when you saw it working?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: It was such a surreal moment. Seeing it working and providing clean water to the community was incredibly satisfying. It reminded me of how engineering can make a difference in people's lives. It made me feel like I had a purpose and had done something good.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: So, what are your career aspirations now?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: I want to keep working in engineering and continue to make a positive impact on communities in need by creating sustainable solutions. My goal is to contribute towards making the world a better place with my work.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: I'm sure great things will keep coming your way. Keep up the good work and follow your passions!
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Your support means a lot. I'm determined to keep going and make a difference. Your encouragement really motivates me to pursue my passions.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: When things get tough, just take a deep breath and remember why you're doing this. This is where I spend a lot of my time, teaching yoga. It's a great way to find balance and reconnect with ourselves. I bonded with Anna during yesterday's l yoga class.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Wow, that's awesome! What new poses did you try?
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: We were trying out different dance poses, like Warrior II, which builds strength and boosts focus.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Is it difficult to do?

turns.text: Can you explain how to do it?

turns.text: Sounds really hard! Here's my bookshelf!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: That's quite a collection! Have you had a favorite book lately? I'd love to hear your thoughts.

turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Great, this is interesting! Have you come across any recent ones that really struck you?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Two weeks ago I read "Avalanche" by Neal Stephenson in one sitting!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: That sounds cool, Jolene. Stories can be so powerful - they can teach us, motivate us, and bring us together.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: I also read a recent story about someone who became successful despite facing numerous challenges. It really showed me that anything is possible if you believe and work hard.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: That's a really powerful message. It reminds me of someone special and their grace and strength when they faced hardships. Check out this creation!
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Wow, Deb! That's beautiful! Can you tell me the backstory of that bouquet?
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: My friend gave me this bouquet when I was struggling, and it gives me hope and courage. I'm filled with warmth and appreciation when I look at it.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: That's really sweet. Such a small thing can make a real difference.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: It's amazing how something as simple as flowers can make a real difference. Nature sure is beautiful.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Where are some of your favorite nature spots?
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Oh, there's so many great places! My favorite is a park with a forest trail - it's so calming getting lost in nature. Then there's this beach nearby that I love - the sound of the waves and the sand under my feet make me feel all peaceful and happy. Do you have any favorite spots, Jolene?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Here's a picture I took on vacation last summer in Bogota. It was so beautiful and calming watching the sunset over the water. It definitely made me appreciate nature's calming power.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: That sounds great, Jolene. Nature's calming for sure. Guess it helps us forget the daily craziness and find inner peace. No wonder you're a fan! I like to come to this spot by the water near my mom's old house. It's where I reflect on her life and find some peace. Being surrounded by nature helps a lot.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: That's so touching! Do you have any little traditions that you do when you come to reflect on your mom?
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Do you remember this amulet from her? Whenever I come here, I bring it with me. It's how I feel her love and stay close to her. Holding it brings me comfort.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: It's amazing how something so small can have such a big impact, huh?
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Yeah, even small things like this can make a big difference. It's a reminder of all the love and strength we have inside, connecting us to people we've lost and comforting us.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: It can keep them close in our hearts every day.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Anna also has a pendant that she wears in memory of her mother! This also brought us closer.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: It's nice to have those reminders as a source of strength when we need it.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Life's tough but hang in there. Look to your sources of strength and you'll do great. Stay in touch, take care of yourself, and know I'm always here to cheer you on!
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Thanks, Deb! Your encouragement means a lot to me. I'll definitely stay in touch. Bye, take care and keep shining!
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Stay safe!  Bye!

turns.text: Hey Deborah! Been a few days since we last talked so I wanted to fill you in on something cool. Last Wednesday I did a mini retreat to assess where I'm at in life. It was a dope experience that totally gave me a new outlook.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Hey Jolene! Sounds great. Taking time to reflect can be really awesome. Did you gain any new insights from it?
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Yep! I achieved so much more than I imagined. It was a real confidence boost.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: You deserve credit for stepping outside your comfort zone and believing in yourself. What cool stuff did you accomplish at the retreat?

turns.text: I really accomplished something with my engineering project - I came up with some neat solutions and I'm really excited about it.

turns.text: Let's go into more detail.

turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: That makes sense. I'm excited to hear how you reach out and help those kids. Let me know how it goes!
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: I'll keep you posted! Appreciate the support! Here are my sketches in the planner.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Sounds like you're doing great. Let me know if you need more tips or information.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Thanks, Deb! If I need anything else, I'll let you know. You're awesome!

turns.text: You're awesome too! Take care!

turns.text: Stay safe!

turns.text: Sounds great, Jolene! I just visited this place and it was so calming. Nostalgic too.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Wow, those flowers are beautiful! What type are they? It looks so peaceful there.

turns.text: The roses and dahlias bring me peace. I lost a friend last week, so I've been spending time in the garden to find some comfort.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Sorry to hear about your friend, Deb. Losing someone can be really tough. How are you holding up?
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Thanks for the kind words. It's been tough, but I'm comforted by remembering our time together. It reminds me of how special life is.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Memories can give us so much comfort and joy.
turns.speaker: Jolene

turns.text: Memories keep our loved ones close. This is the last photo with Karlie which was taken last summer when we hiked. It was our last one. We had such a great time! Every time I see it, I can't help but smile.
turns.speaker: Deborah

turns.text: Wow, looks like a great trip! Where else have you traveled?

turns.text: Yeah, Dave! Feels good when our hard work pays off. It's the perfect blend of dedication and passion!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Yeah, that mix really keeps me motivated and makes it all worthwhile.
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Keep going for it!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: I will! By the way, This is a photo of my shop. Come by sometime, if you can!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Wow, your shop looks great! I'd love to check it out sometime. What sort of cars do you work on at your shop?
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Thanks, Calvin! I work on all kinds of cars at the shop - from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars. It keeps me busy and happy!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Wow Dave, working on cars must be really rewarding.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Definitely, working on cars is what I'm passionate about. Doing it every day is so rewarding! Seeing the transformation is awesome and knowing I'm helping people keep their cars in good condition is really satisfying.
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Wow Dave, that's awesome! Doing something you love and helping others is so rewarding. Keep up the great work!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Thanks, Cal! I really appreciate the boost. It means a lot that my work is valued and that it brings joy to others.
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Glad to help, Dave! So awesome to see you doing your thing and making a difference. Your hard work and talent totally deserve all the recognition. Keep on keepin' on, bud! Take a look at this beautiful necklace with a diamond pendant, that's so stunning!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Wow, that's a great necklace! Where did you get it?
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Thanks, Dave! I got it from another artist as a gift - it's a great reminder of why I keep hustling as a musician!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Awesome, Calvin! Keep pushing and making music, it'll remind us why we keep hustling.
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Yeah, Dave! The road can be hard, but when we remember why we're doing it, it keeps us going. Let's keep each other motivated!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Hey Calvin! Long time no talk. How's it going? Crazy news - I'm teaming up with a local garage. Take a look at what we working on together!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Hey Dave, great to hear from you! That's awesome news about teaming up with a local garage. Super inspiring seeing you follow your passion. Congratulations on this new venture. It's impressive how far you've come since we last chatted. How's everything going?
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Thanks, Calvin! I'm loving this job. I get to work with awesome mechanics and share my knowledge about cars. Here's what I'm currently working on! It's a cool project, even if it's a bit challenging. 🤩
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: That car looks awesome! You're putting in a lot of effort and it's great to see the end result. Keep up the good work. Got any plans for what's next?
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Thanks Calvin! Appreciate the support. I'm gonna keep learning more about auto engineering, maybe even build a custom car from scratch someday - that's the dream! For now, just gonna keep working on this project and assisting customers.
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Wow, Dave! You're so inspiring - good for you for pushing yourself to achieve your dream. Making a custom car sounds awesome. Don't forget to relax and enjoy the process too!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Thanks, Calvin! Gotta take time to chill. Do you have any hobbies that help you relax?
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Hey Dave, long drives in [this car] really help me relax. The feeling of the wind and the open road is so freeing. It helps me clear my head. What do you like to do to chill out?
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Yeah, I hear you! Driving with the wind in your hair is so calming. Taking a walk around is a great way to destress, too. Exploring, taking in the sights and sounds - it's such a peaceful experience.
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Yea, I totally hear ya. Embracing nature has been really calming for me too. I've been loving getting to know Japanese culture. On the other hand, I'm stuck with my music at the moment, like my creativity's frozen or something. Any tips?
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: If I'm having trouble coming up with ideas, I usually immerse myself in something I love, like concerts or my favorite albums. Doing that usually helps to jumpstart my inspiration. Maybe try taking a break from music and explore other things. Plus, have some fun while you're at it!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Thanks, Dave! Taking a break is great for getting my mojo back. I'll definitely take your advice and explore. Appreciate the help! You're awesome!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: No worries, Calvin! Glad I could help. Keep pursuing your music and never give up. You're awesome! 🤘
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Thanks, appreciate it. Won't give up. Let's stay in touch! Bye!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Sure, Calvin! Keep in touch. If you ever need help, just let me know. Bye!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Hey Dave! Long time no chat! Lots has gone down since we last caught up.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Hey Calvin! Long time no chat! How's everything been going since we last caught up?
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Hey Dave, not everything has been going smoothly. I had an incident last week where my place got flooded, but thankfully, I managed to save my music gear and favorite microphone. It's been tough, but I'm staying positive and looking forward to getting everything fixed up.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Man, that's rough, Calvin. Sorry to hear about that. But I'm glad you could save your music gear and mic - those are the important things. Stay positive, pal. Anything I can do to help?
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Thanks, Dave. Appreciate the support. Waiting on insurance to kick in so I can start repairs - fingers crossed it won't take too long. Take a look at my creative haven, where I pour my heart into the music.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: That studio looks awesome, Cal! I hope you get it fixed soon so you can continue creating music. Hang in there!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Thanks, Dave! Can't wait to get back to making music. Anything exciting you're working on these days?
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: I'm so excited, I opened my car shop last week! Invited some friends over to celebrate and it's been amazing. Super stoked to share my passion and help out with folks' rides. It's been incredible so far.
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Way to go, Dave! Congrats on opening your own car shop! Your excitement is contagious. Keep up the great work!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Thanks, Calvin! Your support is greatly appreciated. It's been quite a journey so far, and I'm excited to see what the future holds. How about you? Anything exciting happening in the world of music for you?
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Thanks Dave! Super excited for my upcoming performance in Tokyo this month. It's gonna be great to show my music to a whole new crowd and hopefully expand my following!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Cool, Cal! Doing a show in Tokyo, wow! I'm sure the audience is gonna love it. Wishing you all the luck! Let me know how it goes.
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Sure thing, Dave! I'll keep you posted on how it goes. Thanks for the good luck! Look what a wonderful night!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: That looks great! Where did you snap that pic?
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: I took that pic in Tokyo last night. The skyline was stunning!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Wow, great shot! The night skyline really pops with those city lights. I gotta take a trip there soon!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Thanks Dave! The city lights there are amazing. You should visit, it's awesome!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Definitely adding it to my list. Thanks!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Hey Dave! Been ages since we chatted. So much has gone down. Touring with Frank Ocean last week was wild. Tokyo was unreal -- the crowd was insane. I felt so alive when performing, can't find the words to express it.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Wow, that's awesome, Cal! I bet it was an incredible experience. Congrats! Look what I've been up to recently, that's my neighbor's car. He's been having some trouble with the engine, but now it's done by myself!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Thanks, Dave! It was an amazing experience - the energy and love from the fans was crazy. The car in the pic? It's the one you were fixing up the engine for a friend? Working on cars helps me chill and clear my head.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Yes, Cal! It's not difficult for me to help my neighbors with their cars. Working on cars is definitely therapeutic. Does it relax you as much as it does me?
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Yeah, totally! Fixing cars really calms me down and gives me a real sense of achievement - like meditating. Do you have any hobbies that give you the same satisfaction?
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: I'm passionate about fixing up things. It's more than just a hobby - it gives me a sense of achievement and purpose. I get a real buzz transforming something that's not working into something that runs smoothly - it's like giving it a second chance.
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: That's so inspiring, Dave. You find purpose in transforming things – like when you create something new or collaborate with others. We're both making something great out of nothing, it's amazing, right?
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Yeah Cal, it's kinda cool how we can take something and make it look amazing. Giving it a new life makes me feel powerful and happy - like I really achieved something.
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Yeah, Dave! That feeling of power and happiness is amazing! It's great to see what we created with all our hard work and ideas.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Yeah, Calvin! Accomplishment keeps me motivated. You mentioned Tokyo lit you up. Do you always enjoy performing live?
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Performing live always fuels my soul! I love the rush and connection with the crowd, the feeling's indescribable—it's an absolute high!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Wow, I bet it feels awesome. The connection between artist and audience must be so powerful. Look at the atmosphere in this photo, it's just off the charts!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Yeah, Dave! That feeling is amazing. Everyone is part of it, it's like one big harmony.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: That's awesome! Music really brings people together and creates a great atmosphere. It's like therapy for us all. So, what's next for your music?
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Cool, can't wait for the tour with Frank! I'm buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it's like. Gonna be great playing for folks from home. What do you think of the music scene there?
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Hey, Boston's music scene is awesome! Tons of talented musicians and cool places to play. It'll be a blast performing there - I'll be there to cheer you on!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Thanks, Dave! Your support means a lot to me. Can't wait to experience the music scene there.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Great, Calvin! Have a great time in Boston. Can't wait to hear all about it when you get back!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Thanks! I'll fill you in on all the details when I get back. See you soon!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Hey Dave! Met with the creative team for my album yesterday. It was a long session, but awesome to see everything coming together.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Hey Cal! Sounds great that your album's coming along. Are you feeling good about it? Here's a pic I just took.
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Dave, thanks for checking in. I'm feeling stoked about this album! We've been making some magic with a team in the studio, working on the music and everything. Look at what a wonderful studio we have! How have you been? Anything new since we talked?

turns.text: Hey, nice photo of the studio! Working in a team yields incredible results, well done! Keep pushing it! I've been doing good - thanks for asking. I've been exploring some parks on the weekends to relax - it's so peaceful being surrounded by nature. Are there any chill spots you enjoy in Boston?

turns.text: Thanks! That studio is great for creativity. I've never been to Boston before, but I hear the parks are amazing. Can't wait to visit next month. Anything cool you remember about Boston parks?
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: That sounds great! The Boston parks are awesome, especially in spring. It's so serene when you're walking around. I went for a stroll last Friday and it was amazing. It's so magical - I bet you'll love it! I love taking walks on the weekends, they recharge me for the entire upcoming week!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: I'm excited to experience that serenity. I can't wait to take a walk in the parks and recharge. Hey, have you been on any hikes lately?
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Nah, haven't gone hiking recently, but it's awesome - being in nature and pushing yourself to new heights. Clears your mind and brings a sense of calm. Have you been to the mountains before? Heard they're super chill.
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Nah, haven't been to the mountains but I'm keen to go. Looking for a way to escape it all and de-stress. I want to go on a hike to a place similar to this. What's new and exciting happening for you, Dave?
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: I booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month! Finally gonna be able to see those majestic peaks! Gonna be an amazing experience!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Cool, Dave! Have a great time. I'm sure it's going to be an amazing experience. Take lots of pics and show me when you get back.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Yep, Calvin! Gonna take lots of pics. Can't wait to show you when I get back!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Have fun exploring the mountains, Dave! Safe travels and see you soon. Take care!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Thanks, Calvin! Take care, see you soon!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Hi Dave! Nice to hear from you. Since last chat, some things have happened. I had a lil car accident last Friday, kinda upsetting but no one was hurt. I've been dealing with insurance and repairs - taking up a lot of time and energy. Look at this photo!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Sorry to hear about the car accident, Calvin. I'm glad to hear that nobody was hurt. Dealing with insurance and repairs can definitely be time-consuming and draining. Have you encountered any issues in the insurance process so far?
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Hey Dave, thanks for checking in! The insurance process was a hassle - it took forever and there was a ton of paperwork. But it's all sorted now, and I'm getting it fixed up. Can't wait to drive it again!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: How long did it take to get everything sorted out? I'm glad it's all taken care of now!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: It only took a week to sort everything out. I was worried about the cost, but it wasn't too bad. Look at this photo from the auto repair shop.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Cool! Glad it wasn't too expensive. Who are him?
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: That's the mechanic. He knows the stuff and is doing his best to get my car running again.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: That's great to hear! Skilled and knowledgeable people working on your car - are you feeling confident?
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Feeling way more confident and excited to show off my car! Trusting their expertise.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Great, Cal! It's awesome when you trust the people fixing it. Sounds like they're doing a great job. It'll be back to normal soon!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Thanks, Dave! Excited to drive again. Appreciate your help! Look what a wonderful view from living room!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Wow, what an amazing view! Where is it? I haven't seen anything like that before!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Thanks, Dave! It's from a small town in Japan. The view of the mountains is unbelievably stunning!
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Wow! Did you get to that place yet?
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Nope, not yet! I haven't been there before, but it's on my to-do list for after my tour with Frank Ocean ends. Can't wait to see them in person! Look at that snowy peak.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Looks awesome! Have you ever tried skiing before? It looks like loads of fun!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Haven't tried it before, but it does look like a lot of fun! I might give it a try once. So what's up with you, is anything new in your daily routine?
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Yes, Cal! I recently joined a rock band and have been practicing guitar. Look at this photo – it's us, the guys!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Playing guitar in a rock band is awesome, Dave! It will bring you a lot of emotions.
turns.speaker: Calvin

turns.text: Sounds good, Calvin! Good company and great music, lift the mood and bring a lot of positive emotions! I have to go now. I'll see you soon!
turns.speaker: Dave

turns.text: Thanks, Dave! let's keep in touch, take care!
turns.speaker: Calvin
